name: Latent Normalized Lanczos Resize (decode, lanczos, encode, moment match)
plain: Gets lanczos safely by doing it in pixel space. Soft-clamps outliers, decodes, resizes the image with lanczos, re-encodes, optionally mixes in a nearest upscale, then matches moments to the input latent per channel. Costs two VAE passes.
math:
x=huberize(x); I=VAE.dec(x); I′=lanczos(I,×m); z=VAE.enc(I′); z=(1−a)z+a·NN(x)
out=(z−μz)σx/(σz+ε)+μx; optional correlated noise

props.params: size_multiplier=2, soft_clamp_outliers=True, outlier_quantile=.01, outlier_clamp_slope=.1, add_latent_noise=False, add_latent_upscale_with_weight=0
